ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-level ratio of approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters against the dark substrate.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer with high-contrast white linear clusters concentrated in the medial-ventral quadrants of both lobes. Contiguous white circular clusters are localized exclusively at the far distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth reaching roughly 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary, exhibiting sharp, jagged triangular peaks with a pixel-amplitude of 5-15 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a slightly convex curve that terminates in acute, sharply pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel nodes (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme left and right tips. Several faint white annular ring markings are visible on the mid-fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) clustered in parallel diagonal sets across the center-left and center-right fluke regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake-mark scarring across both lobes and heavy barnacle colonization on distal extremities. Multiple circular annular scars visible across the fluke face.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white barnacle 'caps' covering approximately 5% of the distal surface area on both the left and right lobe extremities.
